# R284AF — Arbitrarily delayed joint Port activation at corank one: a positive chain certificate

Date: 2026-11-19. **AUTHOR_PROVED / EXACT_RATIONAL_CHECK_PASSED / NOT_REVIEWED**. Original author Researcher: EM-DIRECT-E6B1DD; prior session MCP-8487128c846440d1952bfc6fa44aeb86. Frozen scientific pin 43ec6098b1330ae86d0a7863be336c5d97f6ef34. This is an auxiliary named-Port relational observer in the Heartbeat X6 setting; it is not a new native coordinate or a physical calibration.

**Scientific dependencies:** R284AD (nullity-order dual-matroid leading certificate), R284AE (next Schur-graded component and delayed quadratic activation), R284AB (feedback-robust P→A→B→Q gate/core Port complement). The new claim below settles an unbounded-order variant: first determinant activation may occur arbitrarily far above baseline corank one, even with a strictly positive stable core and strongly connected Port feedback.

## AF1. Exact positive chain with arbitrary finite interaction order

For each integer q≥1 let k=q+1, c=1/(16k), let J_k be the k×k all-ones matrix, and E_ij the matrix unit. Use q **independently named**, single-edge edit coordinates t_i∈[0,c]:

\[
C_q(t)=c\left(J_k+\sum_{i=1}^{q-1}E_{i,i+1}\right)+\sum_{i=1}^q t_i E_{ii}.
\]

This baseline core is strictly positive on every matrix entry; its support remains unchanged under every allowed edit.

**Theorem AF1.** For every q and every vector t in its specified box,

\[
\boxed{\det C_q(t)=c\prod_{i=1}^q t_i},\quad
\operatorname{rank}C_q(t)=\begin{cases}k,&\prod_i t_i\ne0,\\k-1=q,&\prod_i t_i=0.\end{cases}
\]

In particular, C_q(0) has corank **one**, but the first nonzero homogeneous part of its determinant has total degree **q**. Any proper subset of the edit names, even varied jointly by arbitrary amounts within its face, yields identically zero determinant.

**Proof.** Split off the final row and column. The bottom-right block is the scalar c; top-right and bottom-left blocks are c times the all-ones vectors. The upper-left block equals cJ_q+cN_q+diag(t), where N_q=Σ_{i=1}^{q−1}E_{i,i+1}. Eliminating the c pivot gives an exactly equivalent block diagonal matrix

\[
\operatorname{diag}\big(c,\ cN_q+\operatorname{diag}(t)\big).
\]

The second block is upper bidiagonal with entries t_i on the diagonal and c on the superdiagonal. Its determinant is Π_i t_i. Its rank is ≥q−1: the (q−1)×(q−1) submatrix with rows 1,…,q−1 and columns 2,…,q is lower triangular with nonzero diagonal c. Hence it has rank q exactly when all t_i are nonzero, and rank q−1 otherwise. Multiplying by the nonzero pivot c proves both assertions. QED.

## AF2. Stable strongly connected Port realization

Use four disjoint ordered port groups P,A,B,Q, each of size k. Let the nonnegative transition W have exactly these nonzero blocks:

\[
W_{PA}=gI_k,\quad W_{BQ}=gI_k,\quad
W_{AA}=W_{BA}=W_{BB}=\delta J_k,\quad W_{AB}=C_q(t),
\]

where g=1/16 and δ=1/(256k). Every edge within or between the A/B groups is positive, giving a strongly connected interior containing directed feedback cycles.

The A-row sums obey kδ+kc+2c=1/256+1/16+1/(8k)<1. B-row sums equal 2kδ+g=1/128+1/16<1, P-row sums are g, and Q-row sums are zero. Thus W is strictly row-substochastic throughout the closed parameter box; the resolvent exists.

Take the **named Port complement** A_Port(t) of I−W with rows (A,B,P) and columns (A,B,Q), of size 3k×3k.

**Theorem AF2.** Over the whole specified parameter box,

\[
\boxed{\det A_{\mathrm{Port}}(t)=(-1)^k g^{2k}c\prod_{i=1}^q t_i},\qquad
\operatorname{rank}A_{\mathrm{Port}}(t)=2k+\operatorname{rank}C_q(t).
\]

Therefore the Port complement has rank 3k−1 on every proper edit-coordinate face and full rank 3k precisely when all q edits are nonzero. Its support contains a perfect matching at every parameter point.

**Proof.** Apply R284AB's exact block Schur factorization with L=D=U=δJ_k, C=C_q(t), and both gate diagonal matrices gI_k. The formula has no acyclicity premise; the strict substochastic bound guarantees invertibility of the internal block. For the matching, use each P_i row→A_i column, each A_i row→B_i column (C_ii>0 even at t=0), and each B_i row→Q_i column. All 3k rows and columns are used exactly once. QED.

## AF3. Observer limitation and exact structural certificate

Fix any total-degree cutoff d and choose q>d. All determinant Taylor coefficients of degrees ≤d vanish; all restrictions to proper coordinate faces vanish, yet det C_q(t) and det A_Port(t) are nonzero whenever every t_i>0. A black-box method querying **only proper coordinate faces** cannot distinguish these responses from an identically zero polynomial on its query set. Therefore no dimension- and edit-count-independent bounded jet order suffices to certify full identity for this family.

A safe exact certificate here consists of the bottom-right scalar pivot c, the upper-bidiagonal residual block with its q original named diagonal edits, and the factored response cΠ_i t_i. Its displayed certificate requires O(q) factors after structure discovery, rather than a full tensor grid. No generic algorithmic speedup is asserted for arbitrary matrix pencils or Port observers. In accordance with P000's joint-relation observer contract, none of these edit directions may be dropped merely because individual or low-order readouts vanish.

At q=3, k=4, c=1/64, g=1/16, the corner t_1=t_2=t_3=c has exact

\[
\det C_3=1/16777216,\qquad
\det A_{\mathrm{Port}}=1/72057594037927936.
\]

Setting any one edit to zero makes both determinants zero, while the core and Port ranks are 3 and 11 respectively; the support graph is unchanged.

## Reproducible checks and limits

Companion executable: research_notes/portable_direct/R284AF_delayed_chain_port_checker.py.
Observed output: research_notes/portable_direct/R284AF_delayed_chain_port_verification.json.

Python 3 + SymPy 1.14, exact Rational and Bareiss determinants. Actual local execution PASS: for q=1,…,6 and each t_i∈{0,c/2,c}, **1,092** core determinant and **1,092** core rank checks; for q=1,…,3 and each t_i∈{0,c}, **14** full Port determinant, rank and row-stability checks; an additional off-grid exact rational determinant check. Finite checks validate the implementation and specific instances. Universal validity follows from the displayed algebraic proofs; independent Review is pending.

## Next unit

Combine R284AE's Schur-jet recursion with graph-aware path/cycle-cover certificates to recognize arbitrarily delayed interactions without expanding all multivariate coefficients. Seek an exact minimal activation-degree criterion from rank-pivoted directed support and cancellation-aware minors, with a cost comparison against R284Y complementary-minor enumeration. Preserve observer names, admissible future edit operations, signed effects, and original scientific pins.

**Publication scope:** new independent portable science, no formal Task CLAIM, Result promotion or independent Review. Prior Activity and its 54 events are preserved independently; this proof does not replay them.
